title: Chrome browsing history
whyItMatters: Lists every page visited, when, how often and what was typed into the address bar. It shows health, money, relationship and work interests in detail.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include History: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One History file per profile. Chrome may also leave History-journal and History-wal next to it. Looked for on this PC: exists (Default profile).
